name: @granularjs/core
description: JS-first frontend framework with granular reactivity. No Virtual DOM, no build step, no magic — just explicit reactivity and direct DOM updates.

scripts.build:minify: npx -y esbuild src/index.js --bundle --minify --sourcemap --format=esm --outfile=./dist/granular.min.js && npx -y -p typescript@latest tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.build:debug: npx -y esbuild src/index.js --bundle --sourcemap --format=esm --outfile=./dist/granular.js && npx -y -p typescript@latest tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.postversion: git push && git push origin v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")

author: Guilherme Ferreira
